dog.description_text:
Meet Miss Pretty!

This adorable girl recently joined Every Last One Rescue, and we can’t wait to get to know her better! At approximately 1 year old and just 36 lbs full grown, she’s the perfect little package. She’s dog friendly and takes the hustle and bustle of city life in stride, showing little interest in all those crazy NYC sounds.

Miss Pretty is exceptionally sweet! She loves getting cozy in dog beds and having meals in her crate. Despite being in a completely new environment she is friendly with everyone and is enjoying her walks (she doesn’t pull & checks in with her walker!). We have been spending 1 hour in Prospect Park in the mornings on a 10ft lead which sets her up for a cozy rest of the day. Miss Pretty definitely has some puppy energy! She can be mouthy and bump into you when she’s running around. It is playful in nature but she still needs to learn her own strength.

She does not jump onto the couch or bed and is a complete pro at crate training. She is very well mannered in the home and will get her people’s attention if she needs an activity to do. Based off of what we know of her she would likely love doggy day care! She seems to want to play with every dog she sees. Miss Pretty has been left home alone crated for just 10 minutes and she was perfectly behaved.
dog.name: Miss Pretty
